Script "Trim All Input Columns" משנה את העמודה: Input0_ProcessInputRow iterates Row.GetType().GetProperties(); for every string property: str = (string)p.GetValue(Row); if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(str)) str = str.Trim(); p.SetValue(Row, str). "" stays "" (not converted to NULL). Applies to all 38 readWrite inputs (incl. Request_Id_73, Source_Account_Number_20, Dest_Account_Number_47, Dest_Fund_Type_43, Source_Curator_Course_Id_18, Action_Type_57, Is_Active_92, Request_Status_58, Transfer_Status_Reason_89, Transfer_Approval_Index_122, Mislaka_Number_152, Appendix_D_Received_154, Request_Cancellation_Date_156, Execution_Date_54, Creation_Date_70, Doc1..Doc4 Code/Mislaka_Name); Appendix_D_Sended_153 is NOT an input of this script. (main.cs:28-49 (DTSX 106313-106334; component DTSX 106152))

Script "Convert gen_isActive from char to int": gen_IsActive = if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Row.IsActive92)) { isActive = int.Parse(Is_Active_92); gen_IsActive = (isActive == 0) ? isActive + 2 /* = 2 */ : isActive; } else gen_IsActive stays NULL. A blank field arrives as "" (staging RetainNulls=false; Trim keeps "") → gen_IsActive NULL. Note string.IsNullOrEmpty(Row.IsActive92) reads the column without an IsNull check, so a truly NULL Is_Active_92 would throw (SSIS ColumnIsNullException, same runtime semantics as in the Update TransferIn note) and int.Parse of a non-numeric value throws — no try/catch → component failure. [תנאי: row leaves through Output 0 only if Transfer_Status_Reason_89 and Transfer_Approval_Index_122 are each NULL or int-parsable (main.cs:135-168); otherwise Error output (unconnected) and the row is dropped] (main.cs:121-132, 165-168 (DTSX 87394-87405, 87438-87441))

targets.writeCondition: Rows of 'Union All' (DTSX 108245) → 'Split Rows For MultiThread 1 1' by ProcessNumber (1..4 → copies 1..4, 0 → copy 5, DTSX 106008). 'Union All' Input 1 = rows successfully updated by Update TransferIn 1..5 (Result → 'Union All - result' → 'Row Update Count'); Input 2 = existing transferins with needToUpdate == FALSE ('Conditional Split' no need to update → 'No Need To Update Count'); Input 3 = rows created by SDK Create gen_TransferIn 1..5 (Created → 'Union All - created1' → 'Multicast 7'), which maps ONLY ProcessNumber and TransferinID, so all Doc*_ columns are NULL for created rows and no annotation is ever created for them. Per document slot N = 1..4 (in order): CreateAnnotation is called only if DocN_Mislaka_Name and DocN_Code are both not NULL (main.cs:68-87); it creates the annotation only if Directory.GetFiles(User::AnnotationFilesPath, DocN_Mislaka_Name, AllDirectories) finds a file (main.cs:93-96); the first slot whose CreateAnnotation returns false sends the row to the (unconnected) Error output and the remaining slots are skipped.

rowFilters.component: Check For Last Row In FIle

rowFilters.expression: script dedup: only the FIRST row per gen_fundnumber (= (DT_WSTR)(DT_I4)gen_fundtypenumber + "-" + (DT_WSTR)(DT_I8)gen_bankaccountnumber) is directed to Output 0; later rows with the same value go to the unconnected "duplicates" output and never reach Create gen_fundmain. gen_fundtypenumber = Target_Fund_course_44 (trimmed, zero-padded) (remove duplicate main.cs:17, 30-42 (DirectRowToduplicates / DirectRowToOutput0; output "duplicates" not connected); DTSX line 38769)

script dedup on gen_fundnumber (see Target_Fund_course_44); gen_bankaccountnumber = Source_Fund_AccountNumber_20 (trimmed, dots removed, zero-padded to 12) (remove duplicate main.cs:17, 30-42 (DirectRowToduplicates / DirectRowToOutput0; output "duplicates" not connected); DTSX line 38769)

which duplicate survives the first-row-per-gen_fundnumber dedup is decided by arrival order, i.e. the Merge Join output order sorted by Request_ID_74 — so Request_ID_74 decides which source row (and therefore which Source_Fund_Course_17 / source fund) is used when several file rows yield the same gen_fundnumber (remove duplicate main.cs:17, 30-42 (DirectRowToduplicates / DirectRowToOutput0; output "duplicates" not connected); DTSX line 38769; Merge Join DTSX 38584-38590 (JoinType=2 inner, NumKeyColumns=1, TreatNullsAsEqual=true); Sort / Sort 1 DTSX 40277 / 40330)

rowFilters.component: Package\Foreach Loop Container\Create fundmain for transferin\Merge Join
rowFilters.expression: INNER Merge Join (JoinType=2, 1 key Request_ID_74, TreatNullsAsEqual=true). 'Split Transfer Direction' sends rows with Action_Transfer_Direction_69 == "2" to output 'Transfer Direction 2' -> 'Sort 1' -> right input and every other row (default output 'Transfer Direction 1', incl. NULL direction) -> 'Sort' -> left input; so a gen_fundmain candidate exists only for a Request_ID_74 that has at least one non-"2" row (supplies gen_bankaccountnumber / Source_Fund_Course_17) AND at least one "2" row (supplies gen_fundtypenumber = Target_Fund_course_44); rows without a partner are dropped. Neither Sort removes duplicates (EliminateDuplicates=false), so the join is many-to-many: m left rows x n right rows of one Request_ID_74 give m*n output rows (NULL Request_ID_74 rows of both sides also pair with each other); identical gen_fundnumber values are later collapsed by 'remove duplicate', but different course/account combinations each reach Create gen_fundmain. (Split Transfer Direction DTSX 40429 (expression 40441-40442; outputs Transfer Direction 2 / default Transfer Direction 1); paths 42817 (Transfer Direction 1 -> Sort), 42818 (Transfer Direction 2 -> Sort 1), 42816 (Sort -> Left), 42815 (Sort 1 -> Right); Merge Join DTSX 38584-38590 (JoinType=2, NumKeyColumns=1, TreatNullsAsEqual=true); Sort / Sort 1 EliminateDuplicates=false DTSX 40279 / 40332)

Left input = 'Sort' <- 'Multicast 1' Output 3; right input = 'Sort 1' <- 'Union All 4' <- 'Create Contact 1..5' <- 'Split Rows For MultiThread' <- 'Add Row Number' <- 'Aggregate' <- 'Multicast 1' Output 1, and 'Multicast 1' <- 'Check If Contact Exist' Lookup No Match Output. The left Sort key and the Aggregate GROUP BY column are the same buffer column identityNumber (lineage Union All 1.identityNumber) taken from the same Multicast 1 rows, so the right side starts as exactly one row per distinct left key: Aggregate AggregationType=0 (GROUP BY), AggregationComparisonFlags=0, NULLs form one group. notes.note: FINDING 1 (Create Annotation): annotations are never created for gen_transferin records created in the same run. 'Union All' Input 3 (from SDK Create … Created → 'Union All - created1' → 'Multicast 7') maps only ProcessNumber and TransferinID (DTSX 108245 component; Input 3 has 2 columns), so Doc1..Doc4 columns are NULL and every CreateAnnotation guard (main.cs:68-83) is false. Annotations are only created for existing transferins (updated ones, or ones Compare Fields judged unchanged).

FINDING 2 (Update TransferIn, NULL reads): gen_requestrejectreason branch `else if (Row.genrequestrejectreason_IsNull) transferIn["gen_requestrejectreason"] = Row.genrequestrejectreason;` (main.cs:136-139) reads the value exactly when it is NULL, and `!String.IsNullOrEmpty(Row.genmislakanumber)` (main.cs:157) reads without IsNull. Compare Fields leaves both outputs NULL in most rows (gen_requestrejectreason is set only in the child-savings National-Insurance reject branch when CRM already has a reject reason; gen_mislakanumber only when the file Mislaka number differs from CRM). Under SSIS PipelineBuffer semantics (ColumnIsNullException) such rows go to CastingError with no Update. If that holds, service.Update can only run when both are non-NULL. Marked unresolved pending runtime confirmation.

FINDING 3 (gen_requestrejectreason logic): the mapped reject reason (45/46/47) is never written to CRM: Update TransferIn writes the attribute only for -1 (sets it to null) or NULL; 45/46/47 fall through. Compare Fields itself sets -1 when the CRM value already EQUALS the computed reason and leaves NULL when CRM has no reason (main.cs:159-168) — the opposite of a normal "update if different" rule. Developer comment main.cs:327-331 already flags GetRequestRejectReason as "faulty".

gen_fixtransferdate compare (Compare Fields main.cs:177) compares gen_fixtransferdateDB.ToLocalTime() with the raw gen_valuedateDB; both come from the CRM DB, so unless the server time zone offset is 0 they always differ and the date is re-sent on every run while the deposit rule holds (likely; depends on server TZ).

Date handling inconsistency in SDK Create (outside source): gen_appendixdsent = DateTime.Parse(Appendix_D_Sended_153).ToLocalTime() but gen_bankingreceiveddate = DateTime.Parse(Appendix_D_Sended_153) without ToLocalTime (main.cs:100-106); same in Update TransferIn (Compare Fields uses ToLocalTime, Update line 167 does not). The two CRM attributes can therefore differ by the UTC offset.
gen_statusleumi on CREATE writes OptionSetValue(0) for any Request_Status_58 not in the mapping table (main.cs:84-85, 215); the update path skips 0 (Compare Fields main.cs:230, Update main.cs:161).

gen_currentdeposits (CREATE) receives gen_sourceisfulltransfer = TRUE when Action_Type_57 is NULL or 2, else FALSE — attribute name and source meaning differ; earlier mapping from gen_currentDeposits is commented out (main.cs:137-139).

gen_transferid, gen_accountnumbersrctext and gen_sourcefundnumber (CREATE, outside source) all receive the same value: Source_Account_Number_20 trimmed, dots removed and zero-padded to 12; a blank field becomes "000000000000".

Silent row drops on the create path (unconnected outputs): competitor not found, destination customer account not found, fundmain not found, second/third occurrence of Request_Id_73, any later row with an already-seen Dest_Account_Number_47 (remove duplications keeps only the first transfer into a destination account per run), and Convert gen_isActive Error. Because staging is loaded with RetainNulls=false (DTSX 190133) and Trim keeps "" (not NULL), a blank Transfer_Status_Reason_89 / Transfer_Approval_Index_122 is a non-NULL "" that fails int.TryParse → Error → row not created (likely; depends on how blanks arrive).

Runtime-failure risks (whole data flow, no try/catch): Convert gen_isActive int.Parse(Is_Active_92) on a non-numeric value (main.cs:123); 'set additional fields' (DT_I4)Action_Type_57 with errorRowDisposition FailComponent (DTSX 104349) for a non-numeric/empty Action_Type_57; Maslulim Convert Dates str.Trim() on null for an empty gen_deliverydate / Appendix_D_Sended_153 (main.cs:56-58).

Update TransferIn versions: 1 ≡ 2 ≡ 3 ≡ 4 ≡ 5 functionally. 1 vs 2: whitespace-only differences in main.cs lines 128/153/170; 1 and 2 have an extra unused input ProcessNumber; 3/4/5 are byte-identical (dupes.json). Mapped separately for traceability.

Unused/dead items: SDK Create (outside) receives Execution_Date_54 and all Doc* columns but does not use them (gen_deliverydate commented out main.cs:93-96). Compare Fields outputs gen_transfertype and gen_requeststatus are never assigned. 'Filter Financial Course' in the outside-source flow can never match (Subject_56 is already "56"). "Remove 0's from gen_source_fundfinanceid" changes Source_Curator_Course_Id_18 after it was last used, so it has no CRM effect.
Update path rows: Update TransferIn always adds gen_bankingreceiveddate when Appendix_D_Sended_153 is not NULL (not compared with CRM), but only rows with needToUpdate == TRUE reach it.

Maslulim: gen_transferid receives the zero-padded source bank account number (gen_bankaccountnumber), NOT the staging column aliased gen_transferid (Transaction_Id_91), which is read by 'Read BY Data From Staging' and trimmed but never reaches the writer. gen_accountnumbersrc and gen_customeraccountdest are both set to the same gen_customeraccount (source and destination account are equal by the filter). gen_identitynumber = gen_customeraccount.Gen_customeridnumber.

Maslulim ExecuteBulk (main.cs:160-186): if ExecuteMultipleRequest throws when the list reaches 20, the exception is caught per row (CastingError) but entitiesList is not cleared, so the `Count == 20` trigger never fires again and all remaining entities (including the failed 20) are sent in one final batch at end of rowset. Ok output rows never get CreateTransferInID.

Lookups: all lookups in both flows read the CRM database directly (connection CRM → psql/altshuler_mscrm); none reads a staging table, so lookupBridges is empty. The CRM DB connection is used read-only here; all writes are SDK (Supported).

Lineage re-checked after the lineage.mjs fix (lineage regenerated 14:36): the only differences in origins.mjs output for all 6 writer versions are the removed '(replaced-by-lookup)' markers on lookup join keys (CopyFromReferenceColumn is System.Null there, e.g. DTSX 94941); no OPEN hop, file field or derived expression changed, so the mapping is unaffected. "Remove 0's from gen_source_fundfinanceid" (in-place TrimStart('0') on Source_Curator_Course_Id_18, main.cs:115-128, DTSX 95636-95649) is deliberately not in readWriteModifications: it runs after the last use of that column, which feeds no CRM write.

Evidence file: source/DailyProcess/0009_LeumiFile-BY.dtsx (SHA256 79CDFAB7A065831820D3E96DF3B65162703C8B0499EAE41DEBAEEA3728827553). Script analysis is on C# source only; compiled binaries not decompiled.

Version differences (all semantically identical): Update TransferOut 1 vs 2≡3≡4≡5 – whitespace only (main.cs lines 92, 96, 100, 126, 146, 163, 166). Update Account 1≡5 vs 2 vs 3≡4 – VSTA template comments/#region Help blocks and whitespace only (line numbers +88 in 2/3/4). Input/output column lists, BufferWrapper.cs and ComponentWrapper.cs hashes are identical within each family, so each version writes the same attributes with the same logic.

Create transferout row routing: Read BY Data From Staging → Trim All Input Columns → Filter for transferout (Subject_56=="55" && Action_Type_57 in 01..04) → Sort (EliminateDuplicates=true on Mislaka_Number_152 only: one undetermined row kept per clearing-house number) → Convert Dates To Appropriate Format → Append Zeros To Fields → Get source customer account (Match → Union All in.2 with Gen_customeraccountid, gen_contactname; gen_currentstate NULL) / No Match → Get contact (Match → Set current state gen_currentstate=5 → Union All in.1 with contactid; No Match dropped) → Get source competitor (No Match dropped) → get tranferout (No Match → Create TransferOut 1..5; Match → check if currentstate equal 3 → Update TransferOut 1..5). Created/Updated → Union All 1 → Create Annotations ×5. All lookups use full cache (CacheType=0) on connection CRM (psql/altshuler_mscrm) – SQL reads of the CRM DB, no DML.

contactid (from Get contact by Id_Number_4) and gen_sourcefundfinanceid are inputs of Create/Update TransferOut but are never used in code: for rows that came through the Get contact branch, gen_contactname and gen_customeraccount are NOT set (the found contact is ignored); the only effect of that branch is gen_currentstate = 5.

Update TransferOut gen_customerstatus logic bug: the CRM-value comparison is part of the if/else-if chain (main.cs:96-101), so an already-correct value falls through to a later branch and is overwritten with a wrong status (2→3/1, 3→1); consecutive runs can flip the value.

Update TransferOut gen_currentstate: currentstate becomes 4 only when gen_isfulltransfer is changed in the same update; otherwise any existing record not in state 3 is reset to 1 (or 5 for the Get-contact branch) whenever its current state differs.

Update TransferOut always sets gen_requestdate, gen_deliverydate, gen_lastpreservationdate and gen_receivedfundtreasurynumber without comparing to CRM (gen_requestdateDB, gen_deliverydateDB, gen_lastpreservationdateDB inputs are unused), so practically every matched row is updated and routed to Create Annotations.
gen_originalreceiveddate (from Revaluation_Date_1) and gen_clearinghousenumber are written only by Create TransferOut; Update TransferOut uses Mislaka_Number_152 only as the record key.

Dates: Convert Dates turns 8-char values into "yyyy/MM/dd" and 6-char values into "20yy/MM/dd" (Registration_Date_75 is 6 chars in the file layout); the writer then does DateTime.Parse(...).ToLocalTime(), which treats the Unspecified-kind value as UTC and shifts it by the server's UTC offset before sending to CRM.

Trim All Input Columns only trims (whitespace-only becomes "", not NULL); RetainNulls=false on the flat file sources (DTSX 190133, 191483). Therefore _IsNull guards do not filter blank fields: e.g. blank Is_Active_92 yields gen_customerstatus=1/3, blank Dest_Account_Number_47 becomes "000000000000" after Append Zeros and is written to gen_destbankaccountnumber.

Lookup attributes (EntityReference GUIDs) are recorded with role=value because the GUID is the value stored in the CRM lookup attribute; the BY fields that found the GUID are SSIS Lookup join keys (Dest_Curator_Course_Id_45, Source_Account_Number_20, Id_Number_4, Mislaka_Number_152, Source_CustomerID_4/Target_CustomerID_31). Record identity on updates (Entity.Id) is role=key.

Lookup join columns (get tranferout/Mislaka_Number_152, Get source customer account/Source_Account_Number_20, Get contact/Id_Number_4, Get Account Details/Source_CustomerID_4) have CopyFromReferenceColumn = System.Null in the DTSX – they are join keys only, their values are NOT replaced. (An earlier lineage.mjs version showed them as "replaced-by-lookup"; fixed in the tool, no mapping relied on it.)

Update Account row routing: Rread BY Data From Staging (BY_FileData_2) → Set Task Name Variable → Check For Last Row In FIle (rows whose Revaluation_Date_1 starts with "@" dropped) → Append Zeros To Fields (Source_CustomerID_4 padded to 9) → Primary Conditions → Select Employer ID (Source_CustomerID_4 := direction "1" ? Source_CustomerID_4 : Target_CustomerID_31) → Multicast → Aggregate Accounts (group-by all 13 columns + Count all) → Sort (Source_CustomerID_4 asc, Date_creation_deposit_source_file_125 desc, no dedupe) → Trim All Input Columns (5 employer columns + Revaluation_Date_1) → Set Account Details (first row per employer id) → Get Account Details (full cache, CRM Account.accountnumber; No Match dropped; its ParameterMap references "#{…\5426:invalid}" but is unused in full-cache mode) → Multicast 1 → Add Row Number → Split Rows For MultiThread → Update Account 1..5.

Primary Conditions casts Employer_Details_Phone_121 with (DT_I4); its error disposition is FailComponent (DTSX ~179741-179792), so a non-numeric phone in an otherwise qualifying row may fail the data flow (SSIS expression short-circuit behaviour not verified).

Update Account: mobile phone is validated on the dash-stripped value but written with dashes; email validated by regex; gen_hozertashlumimgemelupdatedate = DateTime.Now is added only when something changed. Update Account OK/Error outputs only feed Row Insert Count / Set Error columns 1 (ETL plumbing).

Create Annotations: documentbody comes from files in User::AnnotationFilesPath (variable value "FromDB" in DTSX line 607 – real path set at runtime, external), not from the BY file; the BY fields DocN_Mislaka_Name only name the file and DocN_Code chooses the subject text.
Create TransferOut assigns gen_statusleumi = MapLeumiStatus(...) even when it returns null (unknown code) – harmless on create; Update only writes non-null statuses.

Execution order (Precedence Constraints, Package\Foreach Loop Container, DTSX lines 195311-195330): Write By File To Staging → Create ETL Process record → Create fundmain for transferin (DF2) → … → Create transferin Maslulim → … → Create transferin from outside source → … → Create Acount Courses and course partition for transferin (DF1) → … → Execute SQL "update gen_ftrequest,gen_status from 1(active) to 0" (UPDATE gen_ftrequestbase SET gen_existinfile=0, ModifiedOn=GETUTCDATE() WHERE gen_status=1 on CRM, DTSX line 189416) → Create or update  Fund Trunsaction Request (DF3). Consequently DF1 lookups (get tranferin / get source fund / get dest fund) read CRM records that earlier flows of the same run may have created, and DF3 re-marks gen_existinfile = 1 for requests present in the file.

Values taken from CRM vs file: in DF1 every gen_accountcourses / gen_coursepartition attribute except gen_transactiontype and gen_amauntcalculationtype (both derived from file Action_Type_57) comes from CRM lookups; file fields act only as lookup keys (Source/Dest account + course, Request_Id_73) or conditions. In DF2 only gen_bankaccountnumber (Source_Fund_AccountNumber_20), gen_fundtypenumber (Target_Fund_course_44), gen_fundnumber (both) carry file values; gen_fundtypename is the CRM productid looked up by the destination course; all other 32 copied attributes come from the SOURCE gen_fundmain found by "get source fund"; the rest are constants/expressions.

DF1 'get dest fund' SQL (DTSX lines 4693-4697) has a missing comma: `c.Gen_Identitynumber` followed by `gen_fundtypename,` makes gen_fundtypename an ALIAS of Contact.Gen_Identitynumber, so output gen_fundtypename_D (wstr 20) is the contact identity number, not the product. It is not written to CRM, so no CRM impact, but it is misleading.

DF1 'Append Zeros To Fields' has no input columns (DTSX 2930-2935) → no-op; DF1 lookups therefore match trimmed but un-padded file values exactly (full cache = SSIS-side, case- and length-exact comparison). DF2 lookups use CacheType=2 (no cache: parameterized SQL per row, SQL Server comparison semantics). DF3 lookups are full cache.
DF1 gen_accountcourses.gen_accountbalance and .gen_transactionamount are both the SOURCE fund's current CRM Gen_AccountBalance (same Money object) — no amount from the file is used.

DF1 gen_coursepartition.gen_creationdate = destination gen_fundmain.gen_fundcreationdate + 3 hours (AddHours(3)); the version from file Execution_Date_54 is commented out (main.cs:78-79). DF2 sets gen_fundcreationdate of new funds to getdate() from the lookup query, so for a destination fund created by DF2 in the same run the course-partition creation date is (SQL getdate() + 3h).

DF2 creates a fund for the SOURCE account number in the DESTINATION course: gen_fundtypename/gen_fundtypenumber from the destination course, gen_bankaccountnumber from the source account (filter requires source account == target account), customer/employer/agent/bank attributes copied from the source fund, 14 money fields forced to 0, gen_weightedmanagementfeepercentage 0.0, gen_inputsource 1, gen_existinfile true, address fields set to constants (line1 "נתוני קופה זמניים", name "ראשי", city/building/postal "").

DF2 staging column BY_FileData_2.TransferBetweenCoursesType_208 is written from file field TransferBetweenCoursesType_210 (#131, 2158-2162) — names differ; linked by the staging INSERT lineage, not by name. It is not trimmed before 'Filter Financial Course'.

DF2 Merge Join is INNER on Request_ID_74 (JoinType=2, TreatNullsAsEqual=true): a request needs both a direction-'2' row and a non-'2' row; several rows per request on either side produce a cross product (Sort EliminateDuplicates=false), later reduced by 'remove duplicate' (first row per gen_fundnumber, main.cs:30-42). Request_ID_74 is not an input of Create gen_fundmain, so its effect is recorded as declaredSources on every gen_fundmain attribute (role key for gen_fundtypenumber / gen_fundnumber / gen_fundtypename, condition for the rest). The Derived Column for gen_fundnumber uses integer casts with FailComponent on error (non-numeric course/account fails the data flow).

DF1 'set additional fields' (DTSX 19532-19559): IsFullTransfer and AmountCalculationType both cast (DT_I4)Action_Type_57 with errorRowDisposition=FailComponent (its error output is not connected). Any row that passes 'get tranferin' with a non-numeric or empty-string Action_Type_57 (only NULL is handled by ISNULL) fails the whole DF1 data flow → no gen_accountcourses and no gen_coursepartition are created in that run (both branches sit after this component).

DF3 'Compare filed from db before update' → NeedToUpdateAll is now resolved as a scriptOutput (role condition from the 18 compared value/DB column pairs), so the row filter 'Is need to update all' that separates the SDK update (Update Fund Transaction Request 1..5) from the SQL gen_existinfile-only update is traceable to file fields. Only gen_accountnumber, gen_referenceid and gen_requsetidentifier require a non-empty new value (main.cs:126-128, 140-147); gen_identitynumber does not (main.cs:118).
DF2 Create gen_fundmain input gen_address1_city is declared readWrite but the code only reads it (main.cs:191) — no in-place modification.

DF3 Create Fund Transaction Request 1..5 is a direct SQL INSERT into gen_ftrequestbase on the CRM database (Unsupported): it sets CreatedBy/ModifiedBy/OwnerId/OwningBusinessUnit/TransactionCurrencyId/statecode 0/statuscode 1 by hand, generates the primary key with Guid.NewGuid() in SSIS, gen_lastactivitydate = getutcdate(), gen_existinfile = 1 — bypassing CRM plugins/workflows/audit. update ftrequest,gen_existinfile 1..5 is also direct SQL (Unsupported).
DF3: rows whose Dest_Employer_Id_49 (zero-padded to 9) matches no CRM account are silently dropped ('Check IF account Exist' No Match output not connected) — no FT request, no contact, no warning.

DF3: contacts are created (Create Contact 1..5, SDK) for every distinct identityNumber without a matching contact, on both the create and the update FT path. The catch block is commented out, so failures are silent and leave ContactId NULL. Set Final Fields then reads Row.ContactId (main.cs:130) and Row.identityNumber (main.cs:128) without an IsNull check; per SSIS PipelineBuffer.GetGuid/GetString semantics a NULL column read throws ColumnIsNullException → the data flow would fail (runtime inference, not executed). An all-blank Dest_Id_Number_31 becomes "" after Trim and then "000000000" (PadLeft), which can match or create a contact with identity 000000000.

DF3 update path (Update Fund Transaction Request 1..5, SDK): attributes are added only when not NULL, so file NULLs never clear CRM values; gen_agentagencytype is never updated (only set on INSERT, default 1 = External when the lookup finds nothing); gen_status is always true; gen_existinfile always true. When nothing differs (Compare filed from db before update), only gen_existinfile is set via direct SQL.

DF3 Set Final Fields: gen_transtotalamount is always assigned (guard `tempDecimalValue != null` is always true for decimal) → 0 when no amount parses; amounts use decimal.TryParse with the host's current culture and are divided by 100 (two implied decimals). The Conditional Split admits only Subject/Action combinations that the gen_actiontype/gen_subject switch maps, and only Dest_Fund_Type_43 0512/0513, so these option sets are never left NULL on rows that reach the writes.

DF3 calc diff: Row.CreatedDepositSourceDate145 is read without IsNull and str.Length is evaluated before the null check (main.cs:118, 132) — a NULL value fails the component; values shorter than 8 chars → 1900-01-01 → DiffDays < 0 → row filtered out.

Parallel copies: dupes.json proves SDK Create gen_accountcourses ≡ 2..5, SDK Create gen_coursepartition 1 ≡ 2..5, Create gen_fundmain 1 ≡ 2..5, Create Fund Transaction Request 1 ≡ 2..5, update ftrequest,gen_existinfile ≡ 2..5, Create Contact 2 ≡ 3 ≡ 4 ≡ 5. Update Fund Transaction Request 1..5 are NOT in dupes.json but have identical main.cs (sha 095e1055a864), identical input column sets and outputs; they differ only in input column order, generated BufferWrapper/VSTA metadata and (#1 only) a stored breakpoint — mapped individually, behaviour identical. Create Contact 1 differs from 2..5 only by a commented-out line and whitespace.
Rows are distributed to the 5 copies round-robin by Add Row Number* (counter % 5 → 1..4, else 0) and Split Rows For MultiThread* — routing only, ProcessNumber is never written to CRM.

Excluded as ETL plumbing (not mapped): ETL Warning scripts and the Error/CastingError ErrorText outputs of all write scripts, Set Task Name Variable, row counters, Set Error/CastingError derived columns, Get Organization Variables.

lookupBridges is empty: every Lookup in these three data flows reads the CRM database (connection CRM → psql/altshuler_mscrm), none reads a staging table; the staging bridges (BY_FileData_1 / BY_FileData_2 ← Write By File To Staging) are OLE DB Source reads resolved by tools/lineage.mjs.
